identity_and_duplicates.summary: MIT is the official OCW publisher; the Archive subset is attributed to MIT, with item-to-official-course matching still incomplete.

operator.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
operator.evidence: Official OCW course/about/terms pages identify MIT.

facts.representative: Archive MITRES10.S95F20 description links official RES-10-S95F20 URL; published301 reaches the official RES.10-S95 Fall2020 course. Title/topic/term match.
facts.deduplication: One MIT OCW origin candidate. Archive mirrors, videos, transcripts, files, course terms and subdivisions are not extra origins. MIT18.01JF07_LEC01-07 explicitly contains lectures1–7; an Archive item is not necessarily an entire course.
facts.version: Keep native Archive identifier, official course number, term, course slug and individual resource/file identities separate. Mutable date metadata is not an immutable revision hash.

open_questions: Confirm official publisher-to-Archive backlinks and individual course/term/resource mappings across retained examples.

coverage_and_languages.summary: Eleven current native media metadata examples cover six academic topics; English metadata is observed.

facts.country: MIT is US-based; public web access here is from one managed cloud environment with no independently established USA/India vantage.
facts.scope: 2,500+courses is an official site claim, not measured current searchable media supply. No Hindi/regional-language or Indian-provider coverage inferred.

open_questions: Measure language/topic gaps, independent country availability and complete lecture-course coverage.

query_contract.summary: Current Archive Advanced Search/CLI/metadata docs support fixed attributed-collection search and exact native-ID lookups.

params: collection:mit_ocw AND mediatype:movies AND NOT access-restricted-item:true AND identifier:MITRES10.S95F20

facts.response: response.docs identifier/title/mediatype/optional licenseurl,language,date; response.numFound and start. Requested fields explicitly whitelisted; no uploader/account/favorite data.
facts.guards: mediatype must be movies, native IDs unique, errors/malformed/oversized payloads fail. Expected media type is rechecked when later audits count saved examples.
facts.paging: Physics page2 yields MIT8.03SCF16 and MIT_Excitatory_Physics, distinct from page1. It remains metadata-only evidence and is not an additional qualified origin.
facts.empty: Nonsense title and absent native-ID queries each returned200 docs[] numFound0.
facts.partial_metadata: GET /metadata/MITRES10.S95F20/metadata/description yields HTML in result; JSON must be decoded before extracting links. Generic HTML-on-JSON extraction produced malformed escaped hrefs, which are not real leads.

rights_and_cost.summary: Free viewing does not imply unrestricted reuse. Official OCW terms specify CC BY-NC-SA4.0 and explain noncommercial restrictions.

facts.metadata: Archive metadata access under research terms; separate blanket metadata/product license not established.
facts.official_content: Credit, license link, change indication and share-alike required. Cannot commercialize OCW materials; use purpose matters, not merely whether the user is for-profit. MIT marks cannot imply endorsement. Publicity/privacy/moral and third-party rights can remain.
facts.exception_example: Official COVID course hero image credits NIH/NIAID with CC BY, separate from default course license. Do not flatten all assets to one license.
facts.cost: No account/key/payment used for these eleven queries. Official OCW homepage says no registration required. MITx/edX enrollment or certification is a separate service and was not used.
facts.terms_dates: Archive rendered terms observed today but display2014 publication date. Official OCW terms captured today; no revision date assumed.

open_questions: Reconcile each retained item/license/third-party attribution and permitted eventual product metadata use.

reader_access.summary: Official course metadata and lecture links are visible anonymously; no complete playback or full lecture reading has yet been verified.

facts.official_course: RES.10-S95 Fall2020 Undergraduate, Physics of COVID-19 Transmission; collection of LightBoard lectures.
facts.access: Official homepage promises free notes/exams/videos and no registration. Current course page links a separate MITx Online course with problems/bonus content; availability there is not verified.
facts.raw_media: No video/audio/full-course archive downloaded. Metadata presence is not proof of playable files, captions, transcripts or duration.
facts.country_and_a11y: No country-specific network or complete accessibility test yet.

open_questions: Verify official lecture/transcript reader, native episode/file identity, duration/captions, full-item availability and desktop/mobile/keyboard behavior.

quality_and_relevance.summary: Topic queries identify relevant course titles, but course bundles and historic content require context.

facts.relevance: Physics, calculus, computer, chemistry, economics and biology title queries return corresponding course titles. This is metadata title matching, not full lecture semantic search or exhaustive recall.
facts.course_version_caution: MIT6.001S05 identifier suggests Spring2005 while current title says Fall2005; keep discrepancy until official course mapping resolves it. Do not silently rewrite the term.
facts.content_age: COVID course taught2020; no assertion that current medical/public-health advice follows from historical teaching.
facts.empty_not_outage: Both nonsense-title and absent-native-ID cases are explicit successful empty responses.
facts.independent_media: Community-upload calculus hits outside mit_ocw are unqualified and not substituted into this source.

open_questions: Review intended-use relevance and content date/version across samples; ensure courses are complete where described as complete.

operating_limits.summary: One serial policy-gated collector,4-second pauses and128KiB response limits; no accounts, media downloads or automatic retries.

facts.bot_policy: Identifies tool/version/Codex GPT-6. Honor429/Retry-After and access controls. No numeric universal quota inferred.
facts.request_shape: Advanced Search only,GET,rows2,page1–5,fixed collection/movie/unrestricted filter and strict field allowlist.
facts.refresh: Archive terms allow removal without notice; stable IDs do not establish immutable bytes or a deletion/refresh contract.
facts.policy_redirects: Official about/get-started301 and terms307/course301 were retained before following only their published destinations. No WAF/CAPTCHA bypass.

open_questions: Rehearse metadata/license/removal changes and later-session reliability; document refresh ownership before qualification.

decision_and_followup.summary: Retain eleven current query examples and a partial educational-media dossier; C20 now has query evidence.

facts.next_action: Verify official Archive download attribution and representative full lecture/transcript reader, caption/duration/accessibility and item licenses. Complete course/native-item/file identity mapping, metadata reuse/product permission and refresh/reliability. No runtime import or activation.

analysis_refs.heading: C10 — Courses, lecture notes and teaching materials
analysis_refs.text:
**Start with teaching institutions, not course-count leaderboards.** The
[Open Education Global member directory](https://www.oeglobal.org/about-us/members-list/)
is a repeatable route to international institutional leads, including community
colleges and regional open-education networks. Investigate each member's own
open course catalog, repository and public lecture-note collections. Membership
alone does not mean that it publishes eligible material. Use institutional
OpenCourseWare catalogs, including [MIT OCW](https://ocw.mit.edu/search/), as
examples of course organization; this review extracted only a shell from MIT's
search page, so it establishes no machine-search route.
